cited_checks.note: The attested Valiant Theorem 1 declares problems 2--14 #P-complete; the supplied locator identifies problem 7 as MONOTONE 2-SAT, matching the stated oracle-reduction claim.

The attested Greenhill Theorem 3.1 explicitly states #P-completeness of counting independent sets on 3-regular graphs; its interpolation proof supports the stated Turing-reduction convention.
